name: United Therapeutics Corporation
moat_justification: Entrenched prostacyclin leadership, device and specialist-channel advantages and proven pricing power in PAH/PH-ILD, but the franchise rests overwhelmingly on one molecule facing generic and branded competition, with the next growth leg binary on 2027 approvals.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.4x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
one_liner: Quality treprostinil franchise, moat 6/10 — but at $545.08 it does not clear 15% (weighted IRR 7.98%, IV@15 $224.03 vs $545.08 price; even super-bull prints 13.96%); it clears 15% only near $224.
moat_for: Dominant treprostinil franchise across inhaled, oral and infused delivery in PAH/PH-ILD
Tyvaso DPI device differentiation and patent protection reported through 2035
Proven pricing power and margins / returns on capital held through a cycle
Deep specialist prescriber relationships; record starts, referrals and patients exiting Q2 2026
Pipeline breadth inside its pathway — ralinepag and Tyvaso IPF/PPF expansion
moat_against: Single-molecule concentration — Tyvaso alone about 58% of Q2 2026 revenue
Generic / branded erosion already visible — nebulized Tyvaso -18% and Remodulin -6% in Q2 2026, Orenitram generics expected after 2027
New PAH mechanisms (sotatercept class) changing the treatment paradigm
Growth reset is binary — Tyvaso IPF (Apr 2027) and ralinepag (Jun 24, 2027) must land and ramp
Xenotransplantation consumes large capex with no commercial revenue yet
